title: Send feedback
intro: Found a problem or have an idea? Tell us what happened. No account needed.
detailsPlaceholder: What happened? What would make Koolo better?
detailsHelp: 10–1,500 characters. Please don't include passwords, API keys or private conversations.
privacy: Your feedback, optional email, and source page path are stored privately by Koolo. If Telegram notifications are enabled, your feedback text and page path are sent to the site owner via Telegram, but the separate contact email field is excluded. Do not include sensitive information.
successBody: Your feedback has been received. You can keep exploring Koolo.
error: Could not send your feedback. Your text remains here; please try again.
unavailable: The online feedback form is unavailable right now.
rateLimited: Too many submissions. Please try again later.
invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, or leave this field blank.
